description: TypeScript library and CLI that renders AWS Step Functions state machines (ASL definitions, CloudFormation/SAM/CDK templates, Terraform configs or live AWS state machines) as SVG, Mermaid, HTML or PNG diagrams, with diff and execution overlays.
rules: Every public function takes a single object parameter, for example generateSvg({ aslDefinition, theme: 'dark', layout: 'LR' }).

The core 'sfn-diagram' entry (generateSvg, generateMermaid, generateDiagram, SfnDiagramGenerator) runs in Node, browsers and edge runtimes. PNG export (exportPng from 'sfn-diagram/png', async) and the CLI are Node-only.

To diagram infrastructure code, extract the ASL first: extractAslFromTemplate from 'sfn-diagram/cfn' for CloudFormation, SAM and CDK templates, extractAslFromTerraform from 'sfn-diagram/terraform' for Terraform.
